What to cite, and under which terms

Source: R/catalog.R
soil_citations.Rd

soil_citations() returns the citation texts of datasets, soil_licences() their licences, both verbatim as the providers publish them (never rewritten), with the address they were read from and the date of reading.

Usage

soil_citations(x, soil = soil_session())

soil_licences(x, soil = soil_session())

Arguments

x

What to cite: dataset names (character), rows of soil_datasets(), a soil_dataset(), or a result carrying the catalog rows of its datasets in its metadata (a soil_table, soil_summary or soil_export). Client-side: not sent to the API.

soil

A session; the default session when omitted (needed only when x holds dataset names). Client-side: not sent to the API.

Value

soil_citations(): a data frame dataset, citation_text, citation_source_url, citation_retrieved_on (Date), citation_note, level, label, note_key, source_record_id, source_dataset_name, record_title.

soil_licences(): a data frame dataset, licence_text, licence_url, licence_source_url, licence_retrieved_on (Date), licence_note, level, label, note_key, source_record_id, source_dataset_name, record_title.

Details

When a dataset has one text (citation_text, licence_text of soil_datasets()), it is one row with level = "dataset". When it has none (SOTER: the licence differs between source datasets and the records publish no citation; SOTWIS: no citation text), the rows are the catalog notes of kind citation / licence, one per source dataset, with level = "source dataset" and label the title the API gives them (e.g. "Citation proposal of the ISRIC data hub", a proposal built by the ISRIC data hub from the record, not a text of the authors; "Licence (ISRIC data hub record)"). The dataset's citation_note / licence_note explains where the texts are. A dataset with neither text nor notes gives one row with an NA text.

Rights: soil:summary (the catalog is read once per session).

See also

Other discovery: soil_api_info(), soil_capabilities(), soil_code_list(), soil_code_lists(), soil_countries(), soil_country(), soil_dataset(), soil_datasets(), soil_formats(), soil_ttr_flag_legend(), soil_variable_mappings(), soil_variables()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
soil_citations("wosis_points")
soil_citations(c("soter_profiles", "sotwis_polygons"))[, c("dataset", "label", "citation_text")]
soil_licences("soter_profiles")[, c("source_dataset_name", "licence_text")]
} # }
